Abort.et: Originally "remote place", at first in Middle Low German afort (16th century). The contemporary sense as a euphemism since the 18th century. Analysable as ab (“off, away”) + Ort (“place”).

ab ovo.et: Borrowed from Latin ab ōvō (“from the egg”).

Abonnent.et: abonnieren + -ent without a French counterpart, since the second half of the 18th century.
